'''2008 Worlds Day 2 Joe Olson DS Carbon Chamber Testing''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Joe Olson]] at [[2008 World Championship]] (Day 2). Typed sheet title iggy. Handwritten corrections applied (Death Star Sentry for Hell To Pay; Search And Destroy added).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Joe Olson]]
* '''Event:''' [[2008 World Championship]]
* '''Format:''' [[Virtual Sets (2002-2009)|Decipher + Virtual Sets (2002-2009)]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' [[Carbon Chamber Testing / My Favorite Decoration|Carbon Chamber Testing]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
